title: MixEngine package index, schema 2: the root
description: The one signed document of schema 2. It names every kind and the exact bytes of that kind's file, which is what lets one signature cover all of them: a kind file is believed only because this names its hash.

schema.description: Bumped only for a change a current client cannot read. Adding an optional field is not one.

base_url.description: Where release assets live. An artifact is at {base_url}/{kind}-{version}/{kind}-{version}-{os}-{arch}.{format} and nowhere else, so no kind file can point outside it.

kinds.description: Every kind there is. One that is not here does not exist, and one that is here is never dropped. Its file is index-v2-<kind>.json beside this document.
